CourseOfferingParticipant.name: CourseOfferingParticipant
CourseOfferingParticipant.description: Represents information about a student's enrollment in a Course Offering.

AcademicTermEnrollmentId.description: The Academic Term associated with the Course Offering Participant.

CourseOfferingId.description: The Course Offering associated with the Course Offering Participant.

DroppedDateTime.description: The date and time when the student registered for the course.This field is available in API version 64.0 and later.

EndDate.description: The date when the participant's involvement in the course ended.

IsLocked.description: Indicates whether the record is locked (true) or not (false).

IsRepeatAttempt.description: Indicates whether the participant has previously taken the course (true) or not (false).

LastReferencedDate.description: The timestamp when the current user last accessed this record, a record related to this record, or a list view.

LastViewedDate.description: The timestamp when the current user last viewed this record or list view. If this value is null, the user might have only accessed this record or list view (LastReferencedDate) but not viewed it.

MayEdit.description: Indicates whether the record can be edited (true) or not (false).

OwnerId.description: The user who owns this record.

ParticipantAccountId.description: The Account associated with the Course Offering Participant.

ParticipantAffiliation.description: The participant's role in the course.

ParticipantContactId.description: The Contact record associated with the Course Offering Participant.

ParticipationStatus.description: Specifies the participation status of the participant in the course.

RegistrationDateTime.description: The date and time when the student removed the course from the registration.This field is available in API version 64.0 and later.

StartDate.description: The date when the participant's involvement in the course began.

Summary.description: The summary associated with the Course Offering Participant.

AddedToWaitlist.description: The date and time when the course offering participant is added to the waitlist.

CurrencyIsoCode.description: The ISO code for the currency related to the course offering participant.

EnrollmentOfferDeclined.description: The date and time when the course offering participant declines an enrollment offer.

EnrollmentOfferExpiration.description: The date and time when the enrollment offer expires.

WaitlistScore.description: The weighted value that determines the position of the course offering participant on the waitlist.

CourseAttempts.description: Specifies the number of times that the learner has taken the course.

DistanceLearningStatus.description: Specifies the learner's distance learning status during the academic term enrollment.

IsAbroad.description: Indicates whether the learner resides outside of the country where the educational institution is located during most of the academic term enrollment.

IsContinuingCourse.description: Indicates whether the course offering is continuing from a previous academic session.

PriorExperientialLearning.description: Specifies the accreditation through prior experiential learning obtained by the course offering participant.

StudyLocationPercentage.description: The percentage of time that the learner spends at the primary study location during the academic term enrollment.

CourseOfferingParticipant.accessRules: These fields are available only if United Kingdom Compliance and Configuration is turned on.
